title: SDR morning ritual & outreach checklist
body:
MORNING RITUAL (10 min)
- quick dashboard: open HubSpot > Tasks > Yesterday closed/won > Today due.
- check quota: daily call goal 40, emails 60. Keep a timer.
- priorities: 1) demo asks, 2) renewals nearing EOM, 3) cold outbound to target accounts.

TODAY FOCUS (Top 8 touches)
1) (Acct: Atlas Biomed) — follow-up after product brief (sent deck 3/9). Ask: get a 30m pilot sync; champion = Sarah (legal review blocking). Channel: email -> call (10:30 PT). Note: they asked about Dedicated capacity + Private VPC; add pricing link.
2) (Acct: Meridian Health) — inbound MQL, asked for latency numbers. Send 95th/99th token latency for rust-optimized runtime. Action: pull perf sheet, send short summary + ask for demo.
3) (Acct: BrightHire) — expired POC, finance approval pending. Create renewal email with usage numbers + quantization savings.
4) (Acct: Novus Retail) — cold outreach (Seq B). Call voicemail + AB subject lines.
5) (Acct: ShelfStack) — demo scheduled 3/16; prep notes + ask eng for sample model configs (ping Lina).
6) (Acct: CloudFolio) — requeue for canary rollout discussion (dedicated -> private).
7) (Acct: Quanta Labs) — technical follow-up: KV cache behavior question (forward to serving-runtime).
8) (Acct: EchoAI) — check if they saw the fine-tuning price sheet.

QUICK TEMPLATES (short + personal)
- Cold email subject A: "Cut inference cost for X by ~40% — quick question"
- Cold email subject B: "Latency issues at scale? A quick idea for X"
- Voicemail script: "Hi {name}, Ramon from Redwood Inference — quick note, we reduced per-token cost for companies like {peer} and kept 95th latency under target. If you’re open, I’d love a 10-minute intro this week. My number is (415) 555-01xx. Thanks!"
- Follow-up email (post-demo): "Thanks for the time — attaching notes + next steps: 1) pilot scope 2) pricing options (hosted/dedicated/private) 3) security checklist. Can we align on decision owner by EOW?"

CALL SCRIPTS (2-minute warm -> qualify -> close)
1) 30s opener: intro, one-line value prop ("predictable LLM inference, lower cost, fewer surprises").
2) Problem check: "How are you measuring inferencing costs today? Any surprises in token spend or latency spikes?"
3) Quick qualifier: model sizes, peak tokens/s, compliance needs (VPC/HSM?), rollout timeline.
4) Close: "If helpful I can share a short cost/latency estimate and a one-week pilot plan — demo or pilot?"

SEQUENCES + TIMING (best windows based on region)
- US WEST: emails 9:30-11:30 PT, calls 10:00-12:00 PT, follow-ups 3:00-5:00 PT
- US EAST: emails 9:00-10:00 ET, calls 11:00-1:00 ET
- EU: emails 8:00-10:00 CET, calls 10:00-12:00 CET

NOTES TO SELF / OBSERVATIONS
- Shorten subject lines for IT buyers — call out "Dedicated GPU" or "Private VPC" explicitly.
- Engineering questions often land back to serving-runtime; keep ticket template ready: summary, expected QPS, model family, seq length distribution.
- Trial users ask about quantization — save a 1-paragraph explainer.

BLOCKERS / ACTIONS
- Lina: need sample model config for ShelfStack demo (pinged in slack).
- Maya: can you re-share the Dedicated price deck with the 3-tier table? Attach to Atlas outreach.
- ENG (INFRA-789): status on 2x GPU burst availability for Dedicated? If not live, note in call as "limited burst".

END-OF-DAY CHECKLIST
- Log outcomes in HubSpot (call disposition + next step).
- Move closed/won to Maya for AE handoff if $ > $50k ARR.
- Write 3 micro-improvements to outreach (AB test subject + 1-line open + 1 CTA).

RANDOM IDEAS / experiments to try this week
- Test a "price vs latency" email targeting infra leads — include a 1-min gif showing token latency graphs.
- Create micro-case-study: "How X cut per-token cost 38% using Redwood Optimize" (short two-paragraph).

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Who owns public-facing latency benchmarks? (Confluence or product?) -> ping product-hosted-api.
- Are there updated security slides for Private deploys (KMS/HSM) that I can attach?

SHORT LOGS (today)
- 08:50 — dashboard check, queued 8 emails, 2 calls.
- 09:15 — left voicemail for Atlas (Sarah).
- 09:40 — demo prep notes added for ShelfStack.

---
Notes to self: keep the ritual tight. 10 minutes to plan, 60 focused minutes of outreach, then break. Update this doc nightly with what worked.
